title: Video-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement of Video Understanding Agents via Harness Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2609.37950v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Video understanding agents acquire evidence through an executable harness that controls what they observe and how they use those observations. However, execution traces contain only the evidence acquired by the current harness, leaving competing explanations for failure unresolved and limiting the basis for self-improvement. We introduce Video-RSI, a framework for recursive self-improvement in which a video understanding agent uses its own language model to revise its harness. Through active video investigation, the model revisits the original training videos to test competing failure explanations with additional observations, grounding proposed changes in evidence beyond the existing trace. Cost-aware harness evolution turns these diagnoses into reusable revisions and determines which revisions to retain by considering both answer accuracy and visual cost. translated_title: Video-RSI：通过框架演化实现视频理解智能体的递归自我改进
translated_abstract: 视频理解智能体通过一个可执行的框架来获取证据，该框架决定了智能体观察什么内容以及如何使用这些观察结果。然而，执行轨迹仅包含当前框架所获取的证据，导致对失败原因的多种竞争性解释无法得到澄清，从而限制了自我改进的依据。我们提出了Video-RSI，一个递归自我改进框架，其中视频理解智能体利用自身的语言模型来修改其框架。通过主动的视频调查，模型重新访问原始训练视频，借助额外的观察来检验关于失败原因的各种竞争性解释，使所提出的修改立足于超越现有轨迹的证据。成本感知的框架演化将这些诊断转化为可复用的修改，并通过同时考虑答案准确性和视觉成本来决定保留哪些修改。在视频理解基准的各项评测设置中，演化后的智能体……
tldr: Video-RSI提出了一种递归自我改进框架，让视频理解智能体利用自身语言模型主动回看原始视频、检验关于失败的竞争性解释，并通过成本感知的框架演化将其诊断转化为兼顾答案准确性与视觉成本的可复用修改，从而不断改进自身的框架。
en_tdlr: Video-RSI enables recursive self-improvement of video understanding agents by using the agent's own language model to actively revisit training videos and test competing failure explanations, then converting these diagnoses into reusable harness revisions through cost-aware evolution that balances answer accuracy and visual cost.
